text.description_html:
ABH 0128B-US32D Floor Mounted Center Hung Pivot Set

Floor mounted center hung bottom door pivot engineered for durability on interior doors weighing up to 250 pounds. Set includes bottom pivot with installation hardware. ABH Door Pivots are Made in the USA to insure high quality.

Specifications: for ABH 0128B-US32D Center Hung Bottom Pivot Hinge

  • Door Weight: Up to 250 lbs
  • Interior Door Size: Up to 3'6" x 8'6"
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise, Center Hung
  • Non-Handed, Reversible
  • Finish: Satin Stainless
  • BHMA/ANSI C07032/3530
    • THIS IS THE BOTTOM PIVOT ONLY

*Sold Individually
